election.villageastra.rules: The highest exact reputation wins. Ties favor whoever first reached that level without falling below it. Logging out does not remove a mayor. Positive reputation loses 1 point per 20 active minutes. Donate oak logs, cobblestone, wheat, wheat seeds or iron ingots to village chests. Filling each supply up to 64 per chest earns 1 point per item. Taking items is theft. Creative deposits earn no points.

quest.villageastra.rules: A quest belongs to the first player who takes it. Abandoning or missing the deadline costs reputation. Supply and donation count through real trade with the residents; clearing and defence count real kills near the village. A quest that points somewhere hands out a chart with a cross on the place. Adventures are real places out in the world: mine the seam, break the cage, treat the survivors, open the barrow. Their reputation is what puts a player up for mayor.

Follow the chart to the camp, beat the band, open the pen's gate and take the sheep home: with wheat in hand they follow you (or lead them on a lead). Every hit you take cracks one warm egg, and they cannot be thrown. At home put a hay bale in the chicken pen and use an egg on it: with the hen in the pen, chicks hatch. Spare the foxes — the village will notice.

upgrade.villageastra.rules: Every next level rebuilds the building in dearer materials and adds equipment. Level II sets a core into the building, and every next level adds a ring to it: III copper, IV iron, V gold, VI netherite (it takes a netherite block). The research of the building's branch opens the level's blueprint, and without it no core or ring is set. While the hall has an upgrade project, the hall builder makes the core and the smith makes the ring; a player may craft them at a table and put them in the hall chest. A building without its core or ring works at its core's grade. The builders raise the level from the hall stock by its estimate.

core.villageastra.desc.farm: A compost-and-mineral stone at the farm's heart that keeps the soil fertile and moist.
core.villageastra.desc.livestock: A salt-lick and feed stone the herd gathers and breeds around.
core.villageastra.desc.forester: A root mat of living soil by the lodge that keeps the forester's cut strong.
core.villageastra.desc.mine: The shaft's timber-and-iron heart that props the rock so the face may go one band deeper.
core.villageastra.desc.smithy: The firebrick heart of the forge that holds more heat per turn.
core.villageastra.desc.carpentry: The shaft and blade drum of the workshop saw.
core.villageastra.desc.masonry: The stonecutter's cutting bed set into the floor.
core.villageastra.desc.mill: The bedstone under the runner stone.
core.villageastra.desc.bakery: The hearthstone holds the heat longer and feeds the hall.
core.villageastra.desc.clinic: The locked medicine chest the doctor works from.
core.villageastra.desc.town_hall: The village's seal and charter chest; a hall of a higher rank holds a seal of that rank.
core.villageastra.desc.guard_house: The alarm post and weapon rack; a stronger post is heard farther.
core.villageastra.desc.archery: The target archers zero their bows on.
core.villageastra.desc.barracks: The regiment's standard and drill post.
core.villageastra.desc.school: The master slate and primer shelf.
core.villageastra.desc.laboratory: The still and reagent rack of the lab.
core.villageastra.desc.cartographer: The surveying compass rose set into the floor.
core.villageastra.desc.expedition: The packed kit chest of a field party.
core.villageastra.desc.warehouse: The weighbridge where loads are checked.
core.villageastra.desc.caravan: The harness beam and loading winch of the yard.
core.villageastra.desc.engineering: The drafting engine and models of structures.
work.villageastra.doctor_ward: Medic: on duty in the hospital
quest.villageastra.instructions.supply: Sell the requested goods to a resident using Trade after accepting this quest.
quest.villageastra.instructions.donation: Use Trade → Donate to give the requested goods after accepting the quest. Inventory alone does not count.
quest.villageastra.instructions.combat: Accept and defeat the requested enemies near the marked site. Your kills count; completion pays the reward.
quest.villageastra.instructions.escort: Find the people at the marker. Use to follow; sneak-use to wait. Bring them alive to the village.
quest.villageastra.instructions.plea: Bring the items to the requesting resident at their workshop chest, then select Deliver.
quest.villageastra.instructions.handover: Accept, obtain the cargo, and bring it in your inventory to the village warehouse (or hall if there is no warehouse). Select Deliver.
quest.villageastra.instructions.explore: Accept, find the marker in the atlas, and travel there. Follow the objective and status on this row.
quest.villageastra.instructions.captive: Break the cage bars and defeat the chief. Use on the captive to follow, then bring them alive to the village.
quest.villageastra.instructions.lost: Use food or a bandage on each injured survivor until treated. Use again to follow and lead them home.
quest.villageastra.instructions.collapse: Clear the rubble at the marked mine. Use on the freed prospector and escort them home.
quest.villageastra.instructions.beacon: Put %s cobblestone/stone bricks and %s coal in the tower chest. Wait for construction and light the fire on top.
quest.villageastra.instructions.embassy: Hold the issued letter and use on a resident of the marked village. Bring the reply to your stock chest and select Deliver.
quest.villageastra.instructions.caravan: Stay with the named caravan and protect it until it reaches its destination village.
quest.villageastra.instructions.ruin: Travel to the marker and enter the actual structure. Being near the map icon is not enough.
quest.villageastra.instructions.survey: Enter the requested number of distinct chunks inside the marked region. Revisiting a chunk does not count.
quest.villageastra.instructions.relic: Break the mound seal and take the authentic book. Deliver by the laboratory chest, or the village stock if there is no lab.
quest.villageastra.instructions.sanctuar: Take the authentic altar tablet. Deliver by the laboratory chest, or by the stock if there is no lab.
quest.villageastra.instructions.crypt: Defeat the guardian and recover the authentic chronicle. Deliver by the lab chest, or the stock if there is no lab.
quest.villageastra.instructions.warcamp: Defeat the warlord and the remaining fighters at the marked camp. Watch the remaining enemy count.
work.villageastra.mayor_rejected_growth_: Seeking another site: future expansion needs more space

annex.villageastra.rule: No room is kept for an annex: it can be built only while the place beside the building is free. An annex has no level and suits every level of its building.
annex.villageastra.carpentry_annex.desc: The carpenter's lean-to on the west wall of the forester's hut: the carpenter's workplace (planks, stairs, doors, chests and other woodwork).
annex.villageastra.masonry_annex.desc: The stonecutter's lean-to on the east wall of the mine: the mason's workplace (dressed stone, stairs, slabs, glass, bricks) and one more furnace of the village.
annex.villageastra.mill_annex.desc: A tower mill against the restaurant's east wall, its sails on the street face and a passage to the restaurant: the miller's workplace (flour from wheat, sugar from cane) — without a mill the restaurant cannot bake bread the cheap way.
annex.villageastra.kennel_annex.desc: The wolves' lean-to against the byre's west wall: three straw beds, a water cauldron and a meat bin the keeper fills. Four wolves; a rescue quest on the board brings them.
